_schema: Hero banter lines — short personality dialogue triggered at battle events. Keyed by hero_id, then event_key. Optional by_chapter override: hero_id.by_chapter[chapter_id][event_key] takes precedence over default event_key when active chapter matches. Unmapped hero × event returns empty silently.
_events: battle_start — fired once per chibi hero at battle init (player roster at round 1; enemy roster +2.0s delay if S18 enemy banter wired)
player_kill — fired on the unit that landed killing blow (player side only)
low_hp — fired on the player unit that dropped below ~30% HP (player side only by design — adversary low-HP is player momentum, not tension)
outcome_win — fired on each surviving player chibi hero at battle WIN

outcome_loss — fired on each player chibi hero at battle LOSS; ALSO fires on enemy chibi (with S18 enemy banter wired) when player WINS — same event_key, opposite-side fire path encodes the enemy commander's defeat voice
_authoring_notes: Korean. Single short sentence per line (≤20 chars optimal). Voice contrast required across heroes — see character spec docs (design/art/characters/*.md) for personality anchors. by_chapter override (S18): chapter-specific variant for context-rich beats (ch01 도원결의 / ch05 신야 화공 / ch13 장사 / ch16 낙봉파). Override falls through to default when chapter unknown. Enemy voices (S18): 4 적장 (wei_001 조조 / wei_005 하후돈 / qun_001 여포 / wei_006 장료) author battle_start + outcome_loss; battle_scene fires enemy roster banter via _fire_enemy_roster_banter sibling helper.
